elements_selected.content: Three related mobile clipping bugs at 375px: (a) long H1 on Lordianto 2018 clips final letter of "Commissioner" — add `hyphens:auto; overflow-wrap:anywhere` to `h1` in base.html or step H1 down at narrow breakpoints; (b) help page `<pre>` / code block `cargo install --path . --features "reason,history,semantic,mcp"` clips at right edge — add `overflow-x:auto` (and/or `white-space:pre-wrap` for non-code) on `pre` inside `.prose`; (c) landing-page stat-bar shows only 3 of 4 tiles (Orphans clipped) — let the stat grid wrap to 2×2 below ~420px.
